summary.text: Kevin Honan is a Democratic state representative from the 17th Suffolk District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since 1987 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the House Committee on Steering, Policy and Scheduling.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Honan attended St. Columbkille High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Boston College in 1981, a master's degree in management sciences from Lesley College in 1991, and a master of public administration from Harvard University's John F. Kennedy School of Government in 1999.
He has served in the Massachusetts House since 1987.
Ballotpedia says Honan has been a board member of the Allston-Brighton YMCA, Greater Boston Boy Scouts of America, the Healthy Boston Coalition and the West End Boys & Girls Club.
